---
title: "My RNA-seq Analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(deseq2reports)
library(DESeq2)
```

```{r run-pipeline, eval=FALSE}
# Build a DESeqDataSet from your count matrix and sample metadata, e.g.:
# dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~condition)

out <- run_deseq2_pipeline(
  dds = dds,
  var = "condition",
  save_dir = "results"
)
```

See `vignette("deseq2reports")` for the full argument reference.
The pipeline writes per-module folders under `save_dir` (`qc/`, `distance/`,
`deseq2/`, `clusterprofiler/`, optional `wgcna/` / `decoupler/`) plus `index.html`.
